0.headline: Five drafts, zero points, one hundred fourteen up for grabs
0.overview: Pre-season, and the scoreboard is a beautiful blank slate: five drafts, zero points apiece, every castaway still breathing, and 114 on the table for all of them. Tami, drafting first in the snake, opened with Jelly at #1 and stacked five bodies including the leftover Sharonda at #21, though only her best four count. Taylor grabbed Kristin at #2, Kylie took Aaliyah at #3, Tim scooped Lewis at #4, and Austin, picking last, doubled up immediately with Linnea and Jenna at #5 and #6. Different shapes, identical starting line. Let's see whose blueprint holds.

lines.text: Austin sat at the back of the snake and cashed in with back-to-back picks Linnea and Jenna, then closed with Carter and Eric for a 4-of-4 roster nobody can call thin.

Kylie's "Chef, Counsel & Chaos" runs Aaliyah at #3, Cristian, Alexis and Kilby — a chef, an HR head, a defense attorney and a game designer, which sounds less like a tribe and more like a hostage negotiation.
Tami used the first overall pick on Jelly and then quietly hoarded five castaways through Rob at #20 and Sharonda at #21, knowing only her best four will ever count.
Taylor went crisis management at #2 with Kristin, 49, then layered in Ori, Ana and Brady the pro wrestler — chokeslams and voice acting, all still in.
Tim took Lewis at #4 and Maggie at #7 — two farmers, no apologies — then balanced the barn with Devin and Thien An.

awards.label: Boldest draft
awards.text: Tami is carrying five castaways when only four score, betting that depth beats precision.

awards.label: Safest draft
awards.text: Tim built "Two Farmers and a Bus" on Lewis, Maggie, Devin and Thien An — no gimmicks, all four still in.

1.headline: Four tied at the top, one torch already snuffed
1.overview: One episode in and the board is bunched tighter than a Toka shelter: Austin, Tami, Taylor and Tim are all deadlocked at 4 points, all rosters fully intact, all staring at 110 on the table. Tami's got the numbers game — five bodies, best four counting, plus an Idol Whisperer badge. Austin and Tim share the best draft GPA at 3.75, Tami's at 3.6, Taylor 3.5. And then there's Kylie, sitting fifth at 3 points with a 3 GPA, 3 of 4 still in, 85 on the table, and the First Blood badge nobody wants. Twenty remain. Game on, family.

lines.text: Cattle, Cameras & Counseling is perfect through one night, and that late steal of Eric at #16 already grades out as a rank 1 — a 3.75 GPA says Austin did his homework.
The Idol Whisperers have five castaways breathing, the leftover pick Sharonda at #21 grading as a rank 1 steal, and a badge on the wall — that's depth, family.
Voice, Muscle & Mischief got exactly what the team name promised when Brady, the #19 pick and a rank 1 steal, made it his personal mission at Toka.
Two Farmers and a Bus is rolling untouched at 4 points with a 3.75 GPA, and Thien An at #17 grading out rank 1 is the kind of value that wins seasons.
Chaos and Counsel caught the first torch snuff when Aaliyah — the #3 pick that grades as a rank 21 reach — went out first, but Kilby at #18 is a rank 1 steal and 85 is still very much on the table.

awards.label: Draft of the week
awards.text: Five castaways standing, only the best four counting, and a leftover pick grading as a rank 1 steal — Tami built herself a cushion before anyone else even noticed.

awards.label: Ouch of the week
awards.text: Drafting Aaliyah at #3 and watching her torch get snuffed first is the harshest welcome this game hands out.

2.headline: Three-way tie at the top, and one painful blindside
2.overview: Family, we have a three-way logjam at 8 points — Austin, Tami and Tim all banked +4 and all still have 106 on the table. Austin's Savu-heavy build and Tim's all-Toka farmhands both sit at a 3.75 draft GPA with 4 of 4 standing; Tami counters with 5 of 5 bodies, a 3.6 GPA and the Idol Whisperer badge. Then there's the gap: Taylor at 7 with 3 of 4 and 82 on the table after losing Ana, and Kylie at 6, also 3 of 4, 82 on the table. Depth is king right now.

lines.text: Livestock and Lovebirds is 4 for 4 with Eric — a #16 steal now ranked 1 — somehow surviving three days as the consensus boot.
Gavels and Gate Agents has 5 of 5 breathing, the Idol Whisperer badge, and Sharonda at pick #21 sitting pretty as the top steal of the draft.
The Toka Farmhands own the tribe that swept reward AND immunity, and Thien An at #17 is already your rank-1 value.

Crisis, Hustle & Headlocks took the hit when Ana talked herself right out of the game — a #12 pick grading out at rank 20 — but Brady played through a severed thumb tip and Kristin and Ori are still standing.
Chaos, Counsel & Code is last at 6 points with Aaliyah's #3 reach grading at rank 21, but Alexis ran the Savu blindside and Kilby at #18 is pure profit.

awards.label: Draft of the week
awards.text: All four Farmhands sit on the tribe that swept reward and immunity — that's 3.75 GPA and zero sweat at Tribal.

awards.label: Ouch of the week
awards.text: Ana threw out her own name, the room took her up on it, and Taylor's 82 on the table is now the shortest ceiling in the family.

3.headline: Two torches snuffed, two perfect drafts tied at the top
3.overview: Episode 3 took two names off the board and both belonged to the same drafter. Austin and Tim sit tied at 16 points, both +8 this week, both 4 of 4 still standing, both carrying Untouchable and Wire-to-Wire badges and 98 on the table — Austin spread across Savu, Toka and Dina, Tim planted entirely in the Toka farmstand. Tami still holds third at 15 points on the strength of five picks and a dropped score, but she lost Rob and Patt in one night. Taylor sits at 13 with three of four, Kylie at 12 with three of four. The gap is real, and it is widening.

lines.text: Fifteen points and third place is a nice place to stand, Tami, but you buried two castaways in one episode and only 76 remains on the table — thank goodness for that leftover pick #21, because Sharonda is a steal from rank 21 to rank 1.

Taylor, the Savu Crisis Squad took reward and immunity this week, Kristin and Ori are cruising, and Brady at #19 is a genuine steal — but Ana at #12 was a reach to rank 20 and she's been gone since episode 2.

Kylie, Kilby took five votes at Tribal and walked away still breathing, which is the second-best thing to happen to the Chaos HR Department after Kilby's #18-to-rank-1 steal — the worst was Aaliyah, a #3 pick at rank 21, sitting on zero points.

Tim, the All-Toka Farmstand is four-for-four with 98 on the table and a 3.75 GPA, Devin came home from the mutiny twist with an extra vote in his pocket, and Thien An at #17 is the steal of the board.
Austin, Livestock and Lenses is untouchable — four of four, +8 this episode, Eric lifted from #16 to rank 1 — and even Carter missing his ride back to Savu couldn't dent that 3.75 GPA.

awards.label: Draft of the week
awards.text: Four castaways, one tribe, zero losses, and a +8 night that keeps 98 points on the table — the Toka farmstand is fully stocked.

awards.label: Ouch of the week
awards.text: Rob quit and Patt took six votes in the same hour — two torches in one episode is the kind of night that shows up on a draft GPA of 2.4.

4.headline: Four for four: the barnyard still owns the board
4.overview: Day 9 and the gap is real but not wide. Tim sits at 20 points, the only drafter with 4 of 4 still breathing, 94 on the table and a 3.75 draft GPA — Untouchable and Wire-to-Wire, both badges earned. Austin is 19 and climbing right behind him, but he's the only one who felt the snuff this week when Jenna went out. Tami's 18 comes with five names and a dropped score in Rob, Taylor's 16 rides on a Brady steal from #19, and Kylie's 15 anchors the pack after losing Aaliyah first. Three points separate second from fourth. This thing is wide open.

lines.text: Lewis, Maggie, Devin and Thien An all at 5 points apiece — a perfect board, a 3.75 GPA, and Thien An stolen at #17 to boot.
One point back at 19 with Linnea, Carter and Eric still standing, but Jenna at #6 turned into a reach that ranks 17th and it stings tonight.
Five names, only the best four count, and Rob's quit already dropped off the scorecard — leftover pick #21 Sharonda is somehow her number one grab.
Kristin, Ori and Brady are all pulling 5 points, but Ana at #12 sitting on 1 point is the anchor keeping Taylor at 16.
First Blood is a badge, not a bonus — Aaliyah's zero has Kylie chasing from 15 with Cristian, Alexis and Kilby carrying the Chaotic Three.

awards.label: Draft of the week
awards.text: Nobody else has 4 of 4 still in the game and 94 points on the table — Tim is wire-to-wire for a reason.

awards.label: Ouch of the week
awards.text: Jenna talked her way out of the first vote and bought nine days, but Austin's #6 pick finished at 4 points and a rank of 17.
